what.text: This page follows refugees from Togo living in Benin, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4717 Togolese refugees in Benin, 37.3% of all refugees from Togo.
Benin is the largest host of Togolese refugees, followed by Ghana, France and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Togo: over the government, with JNIM, from 2022 to 2025.
The fact pack does not give reasons for the 1993 displacement.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 60 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 155908, at the end of 1993.
That year is the main year of displacement in the data, and the figure has fallen since.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Benin.
These are year-end totals for Benin only, reported to UNHCR.
